description: Lists or answers Chrome permission bubbles ("site wants to: access other apps and services on this device / show notifications / know your location…"). They are browser UI: not in snapshot/screenshot, page tools can't click them, and the page often waits until they are answered. The header warns when one is open. Without button: shows the open bubbles with their exact button names. With button: presses that button (exact name as listed, e.g. "허용", "Allow", "Block", "Allow while visiting the site"). Windows, windowed slots only.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

button.description: Exact button name to press, as listed in the header or by calling without button

multiSlot.description: true only when one agent must handle several slots together (e.g. comparing). Normally omit (one agent = one slot; use subagents for the rest)

site.description: Only when several bubbles are open: part of the bubble title (e.g. the site host) to pick one

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

name: browser_permission
title: Answer permission bubble
